summary: The purpose of this report is to seek Council approval for temporary daily short-term curb lane closures on a section of Highway 27 in the vicinity of Finch Avenue West and Humber College Boulevard. The proposed lane closures will be implemented intermittently during the off-peak period and to undertake early works for the Finch West Light Rail Transit (LRT) construction. The temporary lane closures are being requested from May 2019 to October 2019. The report further seeks Council authority to close a portion of the boulevard space within the northwest, northeast, southeast and southwest quadrants of the intersection of Highway 27 and Finch Avenue West. These areas of land are required for construction material and equipment laydown purposes during construction of the LRT portal and guideway. The proposed boulevard closures are being requested for a period of 51 months (May 31, 2019 to August 31, 2023). With the proposed closures in place, all traffic lanes and sidewalks on Highway 27 and Finch Avenue West will be maintained. Finally, the General Manager's current delegated authority in relation to the Finch West LRT to temporarily close to pedestrian and vehicular traffic highways or portions of highways for a period up to and including 365 consecutive days is valid until March 31, 2020. City Council amend City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 937, Temporary Closing of Highways, to delegate to the General Manager, Transportation Services, despite section 937-4 of Code Chapter 937, from May 16, 2019 to October 31, 2019, the authority to temporarily close to vehicular traffic portions of the northbound and southbound curb lanes on Highway 27, between 200 metres south of Humber College Boulevard and 100 metres north of Finch Avenue West, daily between 9:30 a.m. and 3:30 p.m. as required but ending no later than October 31, 2019, for the purposes of the construction of the Finch West Light Rail Transit project, and exempt the General Manager, Transportation Services, in carrying out this delegated authority from Section 937-5 of Chapter 937, that being the requirement to notify the local Ward Councillor of the pending closure and the requirement to report on the proposed closure if so requested by the local Ward Councillor. 2. City Council close the boulevard spaces within the northwest, northeast, southeast and southwest quadrants of the intersection of Highway 27 and Finch Avenue West, as shown shaded in Attachment 1 to the report (April 9, 2019) from the General Manager, Transportation Services, from May 31, 2019 to August 31, 2023. 3.
